pipeline_mapping: **the soil-mechanics force model behind our `Drilling / excavation energy` row (operational_costs.csv, 200 Wh/kg median)**: analytical drawbar-force model for digging lunar regolith from standard soil-strength parameters — the physics that converts loose-vs-consolidated into a force/energy split.
